conflict: The paper/Japan38 membership audit places the sequenced sample in the Japanese panel, while the currently accepted species concept has no native Japanese range. Exact taxon-name matching therefore cannot be treated as evidence that the JPN_29 nuclear tip represents a natural Japanese C. verutum population.

required_next_evidence: Resolve the exact Moreyra voucher/locality for SAMN44017947 / SRR30887232.
Determine whether the sampled material was cultivated in Japan, misidentified, or uses a different taxonomic concept.
Only after voucher-level reconciliation decide whether a Japan-local colour phenotype is biologically meaningful for this tip.

claim_boundary: This is an identity/geography gate, not a reidentification of the sequence. POWO distribution absence does not by itself prove that the sequenced sample is wrong; it makes the current Japan-local phenotype join unsafe until voucher-level evidence resolves the contradiction.
